name: Prevalence of undernourishment
definition_long: Share of the population whose habitual food consumption is insufficient to provide the dietary energy levels required to maintain a normal active and healthy life. Three-year average.
sources: Food balance sheets and household budget survey

name: Net enrolment rate in primary education
definition_long: Children of official primary school age who are enrolled in primary education as a share of the population of that age group.

name: Under-five mortality rate
definition_long: Probability that a child born in a given year dies before reaching age five. Expressed per 1000 live births.

name: Poverty headcount ratio at national poverty line
definition_long: Share of the population living below the national poverty line. Based on household consumption per adult equivalent.
